title: Khasnadda ku hoos libdhay kibirka
intro: Bal qiyaas inaad hor taagan tahay hanti aad u badan oo si fudud u qaadi karta furayaasha ayaa daali doonta koox dad ah oo xooggan. Adigoo agtaada jooga, codadku waxay dhiirigelinayaan is-hoosaysiin iyo xusuus, haddana kibirku wuu ka sii weyn yahay mahadnaqa. Maxaa dhacaya marka deeqdu noqoto imtixaan isla weynaantuna ay shaabadayso natiijada?
clues: Waxaan ka mid ahaa reer Muuse, haddana waan ku xadgudbay.
Waxaa la i siiyay khasnado aad u badan oo furayaasha ay culays ku saari karaan koox rag xoog leh.
Dadkaygu waxay igula taliyeen inaanan ku farxin oo aan raadsado Aakhiro anigoo aan ilaawin qaybtayda adduunka.
Waxaan sheegtay in waxa aan haysto la i siiyay oo keliya aqoonta aan haysto awgeed.
Waxaan dadkayga hortooda ku soo bandhigay anigoo qurxinaya, kuwa doonaya nolosha adduunkuna waxay rabeen wax la mid ah waxa aan haysto.
Dhulkii iyo hoygeygaba waxaa la i liqay, mana jirin cid i caawin karta mana aanan is caawin karin.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Ku faanayay hantidii oo diiday nimcada Alle inkastoo la taliyay.
Wuxuu Ibraahim ku xujeeyay nolosha iyo dhimashada
Wuxuu hoggaaminayay ciidan ka dhan ah Talut iyo Daa'uud

Walaal ayuu u dilay xaasidnimo darteed qurbaan uu bixiyay awgeed
trial.answer: Ku faanayay hantidii oo diiday nimcada Alle inkastoo la taliyay.

outcome.answer: Dhulku wuxuu liqay hoy iyo maal leh

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
